career_ladder.note: Direct recruitment to the Cadre of Civil Judge in the Rajasthan Judicial Service (RJS) is conducted by the High Court of Judicature for Rajasthan at Jodhpur in accordance with the Rajasthan Judicial Service Rules, 2010. Successful candidates undergo institutional judicial training at the Rajasthan State Judicial Academy (RSJA), Jodhpur, followed by field court training before independent magisterial posting. Promotional hierarchy extends to the Higher Judicial Service (District & Sessions Judge Cadre) and constitutional elevation to the High Court bench.

exam_scheme.note: The Rajasthan Judicial Service (Civil Judge Cadre) Examination is a competitive three-tier selection process governed by Rule 20 and Rule 23 of the Rajasthan Judicial Service Rules, 2010. It comprises: (1) Preliminary Examination (Objective OMR test of 100 marks, 2 hours duration, no negative marking, strictly qualifying for Mains), (2) Main Written Examination (Subjective written test of 4 papers totaling 300 marks), and (3) Viva-Voce / Personal Interview (35 marks). Final merit list is compiled on the cumulative aggregate marks secured in the Main Written Examination and Interview (335 marks total).

financial_package.note: Civil Judges in Rajasthan are remunerated in the revised judicial pay scale of ₹77,840 – ₹1,36,520 (Entry Basic Pay ₹77,840) in accordance with the Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) recommendations accepted by the Supreme Court of India. Project dearness allowance is 58% as of review date. Judicial officers are entitled to extensive statutory perks including official furnished bungalow or judicial quarters, staff car / conveyance allowance, sumptuary allowance, robe grant, and comprehensive medical coverage under judicial rules.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Rajasthan High Court Detailed Advt. No. 783 Section 5 Pay Scale
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross monthly salary comprises Entry Basic Pay ₹77,840 + 58% DA (₹45,147) + House Rent Allowance (10% to 27% where official judicial bungalow is not occupied) + Sumptuary Allowance, Electricity & Water reimbursement, and Telephone/Broadband allowance. In-hand salary factors in statutory deductions under NPS (10% of Basic+DA = ₹12,299), judicial group insurance, and professional taxes.
official_perks: Official earmarked judicial residence / furnished bungalow with camp office facility or full HRA
Official government vehicle with driver or monthly Conveyance / Fuel Allowance
Sumptuary Allowance (₹2,500 - ₹5,000 per month) and triennial Robe / Uniform grant
Cashless indoor and outdoor medical reimbursement for judicial officer and dependents under RGHS / Judicial Medical Rules
Round-the-clock Personal Security Officer (PSO) and residential security guards
Electricity and water consumption reimbursement, residential broadband/mobile bills, and Leave Travel Concession (LTC)

competition_benchmarks.note: The Rajasthan Judicial Service Civil Judge Cadre Examination is among the most competitive law examinations in India. In the 2024 recruitment cycle, 222 vacancies (accumulated across 2022, 2023, and 2024) were advertised, attracting approximately 45,000 law graduates. A total of 3,761 candidates qualified the Preliminary Examination for the Main Examination. Final selection was declared on 27.10.2024 recommending 222 candidates.
